data.text:
'MAG-IINGAY SA EDSA': YOUTH, PROGRESSIVE GROUPS STAGE NOISE BARRAGE FOR ACCOUNTABILITY

Progressive groups staged a "White Friday Noise Barrage" at the historic People Power Monument to demand accountability in the multibillion-peso flood control scandal.

Led by Akbayan Partylist, Akbayan Youth, Youth Against Kurakot (YAK!), the Student Council Alliance of the Philippines (SCAP), and Tindig Pilipinas, the protest built on the momentum of the recent Trillion Peso March and amplified calls for transparency and punishment of corrupt politicians and contractors.

Akbayan Youth Secretary General and YAK! convenor Khylla Meneses said public outrage remains unresolved, describing the resignation of Ako Bicol Party-list Rep. Zaldy Co and Vice President Sara Duterte's budget request as a political spectacle aimed at dodging scrutiny.

SCAP Secretary General Matthew Silverio noted the growing unrest in schools and universities, pointing to student actions that reflect mounting frustration with corruption.

The groups pledged to sustain their campaign for transparency and reforms until full accountability is achieved.

📷 Akbayan Partylist
